1. Our Commitment to Privacy

AACP™ Career Navigator supports career exploration, career intelligence and personalized education planning through a privacy-by-design approach.

AACP™ is committed to minimizing personal information collection, protecting student information, promoting student autonomy and supporting the responsible use of artificial intelligence.

2. Information We Collect

All Career Navigator users must register an account to access platform services.

Career Navigator applies a data minimization approach, collecting information necessary to administer accounts and deliver authorized services.

Depending on the features accessed, information collected may include:

Account and authentication information

  • Unique account identification code.
  • Email address.
  • Authentication information.
  • Age eligibility information.

Career and education planning information

  • Grade level.
  • Completed and planned courses.
  • Career interests and preferences.
  • Self-identified strengths and activity preferences.
  • Saved careers and career plans.

Administrative information

  • Subscription status.
  • Applicable consent and authorization records.
  • Sharing permissions and associated audit records.
  • Limited operational information necessary for security and service administration.

Career Navigator does not require students to provide their real names.

The platform does not collect exact dates of birth, Alberta Student Numbers, academic marks or academic transcripts.

3. How We Use Personal Information

Personal information is used to:

  • Create, authenticate and administer user accounts.
  • Provide personalized career exploration and education planning.
  • Deliver authorized platform features.
  • Manage subscriptions and payments.
  • Facilitate authorized career plan sharing.
  • Manage applicable consent and parental authorization.
  • Maintain platform security and functionality.
  • Respond to account support and privacy inquiries.
  • Meet applicable legal and institutional obligations.

AACP™ does not sell student personal information or use student career profiles for third-party targeted advertising.

4. Data Hosting and Security

Consent records and ACIA™ processing are hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) in the Canada (Central) region. Other Career Navigator account and career planning data is currently stored with our cloud database provider, Cloudflare, in North America, which may include the United States.

AACP™ maintains administrative and technical safeguards designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration and loss.

Third-party payment and other service providers may operate under separate data processing and retention arrangements.

5. Artificial Intelligence and ACIA™

ACIA™ provides supplementary career intelligence through the AACP Intelligence Gateway hosted in Canada.

Student messages, conversation histories, personal information and account identifiers are not transmitted to external AI providers through ACIA™.

ACIA™ prioritizes verified career and education information. Where supplementary AI-generated guidance is required, external AI services receive controlled, non-identifying requests.

AI-generated responses are subject to privacy, safety and content validation before being presented to users.

Student conversation content is not retained on Career Navigator's application servers.

Limited, non-identifying operational events may be recorded to support service quality, safety and security.

ACIA™ provides advisory career guidance and does not determine academic admission, professional licensing, employment eligibility or student suitability for specific careers.

6. Student Safety

ACIA™ incorporates age-appropriate privacy and safety safeguards.

Requests outside its educational scope may be restricted.

Where appropriate, students may be directed to relevant support resources, trusted adults or qualified professionals.

ACIA™ is not a mental health counselling, emergency response or actively monitored crisis service.

7. Consent and Authorization

Access to applicable Career Navigator features is subject to student consent and parental or guardian authorization where required.

Authorization for ACIA™ AI-assisted career guidance is separate from general platform participation.

Where parental or guardian authorization is required, access to affected features is restricted until the applicable authorization is obtained.

Users may withdraw optional consent, subject to applicable legal requirements. Withdrawal may affect access to features requiring that consent.

Institutional deployments may require additional school or school board authorization.

8. Student-Controlled Sharing

Students choose who can view their career plans.

Authorized teachers, career advisors, parents and guardians receive view-only access.

Students may revoke access at any time, with immediate effect.

Sharing and revocation activities are recorded for accountability.

Payment for a student's subscription does not automatically grant access to the student's career plan or personal information.

Authorized recipients are expected to respect student privacy and applicable access restrictions.

9. Account Deletion and Data Retention

Students can independently delete their Career Navigator accounts through the platform.

Personal information associated with the active account is erased upon deletion, and a confirmation email is issued.

Personal information is retained only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfil its stated purposes or meet applicable legal, financial, security and administrative obligations.

Limited information may remain in secure backups or legally required transaction records for applicable retention periods.

10. Payments and Third-Party Services

Career Navigator is a commercial platform offering free and paid subscription services.

Payments are processed through Stripe.

Payment information is handled separately from student career planning information.

Third-party service providers may support:

  • Cloud hosting and infrastructure.
  • Payment processing.
  • Account verification and communications.
  • Controlled, non-identifying AI processing.

Information disclosed to service providers is limited to what is necessary to deliver the applicable service.

11. Institutional Privacy and Access

Career Navigator may be provided through schools, school boards and other educational institutions.

Institutional deployments are subject to applicable privacy requirements, institutional approvals and agreed data protection arrangements.

Institutional licensing or subscription sponsorship does not automatically grant access to individual student information.

Additional institutional privacy and authorization requirements may apply.

12. Privacy Rights

Subject to applicable legislation, users may request:

  • Access to their personal information.
  • Correction of inaccurate information.
  • Withdrawal of applicable consent.
  • Revocation of authorized sharing permissions.
  • Account deletion.
  • Information about the collection, use and disclosure of their personal information.

Users may contact AACP™ regarding privacy concerns or requests using the contact information provided below.

13. Applicable Privacy Legislation

AACP™ is committed to handling personal information in accordance with applicable Canadian privacy legislation.

School and school board deployments may be subject to additional public-sector privacy requirements and institutional agreements.

14. Policy Updates

AACP™ may update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in platform functionality, privacy practices, legal requirements or institutional arrangements.

Users will be notified of material changes.

Renewed consent or authorization may be required where applicable.
